author: scaffold
description: Hand-port of problem_073 (fused encoder RMSNorm + cross-attention K/V projection); custom __global__ kernel with destination-passing style; FP16 inputs/outputs, FP32 accumulator with 4-way pairwise reduction in the dot product. Normalized vector is FP16-quantised in shared memory to match the upstream PyTorch reference's `(norm_weight * hidden_states).to(input_dtype)` precision profile; this is what closes the tightest workload's 99% matched-ratio gate near zero outputs. Passes 16/16 workloads under sol-execbench on the live sm_120 host.
